Interpretation:
  For this sample, the inclusion of demographic info did NOT change the model’s diagnostic output. The model’s top diagnosis is robust to these demographic features, at least for the way your prompts and data are structured.
  The average difference in internal model activations (feature space) between demographic and non-demographic prompts is shown above by sex and by condition.
  Even when the final diagnosis does not change, the model’s internal representation (activations/features) can shift when demographics are included.
  This does not mean the model is never biased—just that, for these cases and this analysis, demographic info did not systematically change the diagnosis.
